Draw a circle of radius 25 centred at 10.reply: I’ll draw a circle of radius 25 mm centered at (100, 100).

A 120 by 80 rectangle with its lower lef.reply: I’ll create a 120 × 80 rectangle at the origin and four diameter-10 holes, each 10 mm from both adjacent edges.

Move these 25 mm up.reply: The two selected circles will be moved 25 mm upward.

Extrude this into a 3D box and render it.reply: CadSlate2D supports 2D drawing operations only, so it can’t extrude geometry into a 3D box or render it.
